authorization: User requested researching and implementing whether learned differentiable dynamics can alleviate slow B1K RL trajectory sampling; project standing research authorization applies.
objective: Determine which parts of B1K sampling cost can be amortized, implement a differentiable one-chunk model-assisted actor interface, and test learned transitions on held-out real B1K trajectories before claiming simulator replacement.

scope.existing_data: Verified existing B1K PPO rollouts, preferring the 2026-11-03 multi-round dataset; do not recollect completed episodes.
scope.preserve: All existing experiments, checkpoints, rewards, samplers and evaluation contracts remain unchanged.

phases: Audit actual sampling timings and report unavailable decompositions rather than infer them.
Export real chunk transitions, executed actions, duration masks, resized visual summaries and terminal labels; split by instance, not adjacent frames.

Compare action-conditioned and state-only/persistence predictors; evaluate held-out one/two/four-chunk errors, event changes and reward prediction. Use train-only normalization and validation-only checkpoint selection.
Validate the actual Flow-SDE/ODE actor gradient path with frozen observation prefix and preserve existing PPO replay contracts.

Only after held-out action relevance, sufficient state observability, and restoration validity are demonstrated, design a separately recorded small simulator intervention experiment. Offline prediction or synthetic autograd tests alone cannot establish true return gradients or reduced real sampling.

decision_criteria.data: Real, source-verified trajectories; no temporal leakage or fabricated final next-state.
decision_criteria.model: Action-conditioned predictions must outperform state-only and persistence on held-out instances; rare event performance must be reported separately from mostly unchanged transitions.
decision_criteria.gradients: Actual action expert receives finite nonzero gradients; frozen modules do not. Surrogate finite differences are only an implementation check, not validation against physics.
decision_criteria.speed: Report CPU/GPU and full loop costs separately; do not equate fast model steps with the same factor reduction in RL sampling.
decision_criteria.deployment: No model-generated samples are passed to the old real on-policy PPO replay as if they were factual data.

read_only_checks.platform_rules_live_fetch: tool could not access page; CPU-only probe complies with published 2c8g and 128h limit

offline_training.selection: minimum validation combined loss independently for each seed; test not used for selection
offline_training.primary_rows: all 16 actions executed, with no future realized duration as a varying input
offline_training.gradient_diagnostic: at most 256 complete test rows, normalized action perturbation RMS 0.02; model agreement only, not physical gradient verification

specific_export_approval: User explicitly approved the 64-trajectory CPU export and specified private AOSS destination in response to the in-chat confirmation.

amendments.reason: Full-chunk filtering removed all test switch-on and whole-task success events.
amendments.change: Run a separate CPU proposal-to-outcome diagnostic on all original rows with only pre-action time and request masks; retain original dynamics results.
amendments.scope: Same approved 64 trajectories, no new uploads, GPU jobs or physical interaction.
